criteria.requirement: Add Path.atomic_write(content,*,encoding="utf-8",if_changed=False). Validate and encode str/bytes before creating a same-directory temp, flush/fsync, retain old mode or use 0600 when new, replace atomically and clean failure paths. Reject symlinks; if_changed=True preserves inode/mtime/mode when bytes match and returns False, otherwise True. Serialization/replace failures preserve old bytes. Keep ordinary write methods unchanged and do not promise concurrent compare-and-swap or directory-fsync crash guarantees.
